items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Billy Gladstone, Max Manne, Carl Glassman, and Murray Spivack. Whenever it came time for something to come up to do special, they called one of those guys.

ctx.x: Vic Firth? Oh, even before that. Okay. Let’s go on to the fourth one.
Yeah, Max Manne. Oh – Carl Glassman. He was a tympani player. And then the snare drummer – oh, Murray Spivack. Yeah, Murray Spivack. There was – first of all, there was – who else?
